tagline.en: A compact vision-language-action backbone built on LLaVA-Pythia, offered in 400M, 700M, and 1.3B sizes for lightweight robot policy training.
tagline.zh: 基于 LLaVA-Pythia 的轻量视觉-语言-动作骨干,提供 400M、700M、1.3B 三种规模,面向轻量机器人策略训练。

en: TinyVLA is a small vision-language-action model aimed at embodied control on modest hardware. It pairs a LLaVA-Pythia language-vision backbone with CLIP/SigLIP vision fusion and an action head, so a robot can turn an image and a language instruction into predicted actions.

The published backbones come in three sizes — 400M, 700M, and 1.3B — and the action head can be either an ACT-style predictor or a conditional 1D diffusion head. These released weights are VLM backbones intended for policy training: you fine-tune on your own robot data, together with the matching normalization statistics, to obtain a task-ready policy.

In WorldFoundry, TinyVLA runs through the shared action runtime. Both merged weights and a local LoRA plus non-LoRA action tensors are supported, so you can bring your own trained checkpoint and drive action prediction directly.
zh: TinyVLA 是一个面向具身控制、可在普通硬件上运行的小型视觉-语言-动作模型。它把 LLaVA-Pythia 的语言-视觉骨干与 CLIP/SigLIP 视觉融合、动作头结合起来,让机器人能把一张图像加一条语言指令转成预测动作。
已发布的骨干提供 400M、700M、1.3B 三种规模,动作头可以是 ACT 式预测器,也可以是条件式一维扩散头。这些权重是用于策略训练的 VLM 骨干:你需要在自己的机器人数据上做微调,并配套对应的归一化统计量,才能得到可直接执行任务的策略。
在 WorldFoundry 中,TinyVLA 通过统一的动作运行时执行。它同时支持合并后的权重,以及本地的 LoRA 加非 LoRA 动作张量,因此你可以带上自己训练好的 checkpoint,直接进行动作预测。

whenToUse.en: Pick TinyVLA when you want a small, easy-to-train VLA backbone for imitation learning on a specific robot and task, and you plan to fine-tune it on your own demonstrations.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个小巧、易训练的 VLA 骨干,在特定机器人和任务上做模仿学习,并打算用自己的示范数据微调时,TinyVLA 是合适的选择。

notFor.en: It is not a plug-and-play robot policy — the released weights are backbones for training, so you must supply a task-trained action checkpoint and its normalization statistics before it can act.
notFor.zh: 它不是即插即用的机器人策略——发布的权重是用于训练的骨干,你必须自备经任务训练的动作 checkpoint 及其归一化统计量,它才能产生动作。

en: LLaVA-Pythia backbone with CLIP/SigLIP vision fusion
Choice of ACT or conditional 1D diffusion action head
Works with merged weights or local LoRA plus action tensors
zh: LLaVA-Pythia 骨干,配 CLIP/SigLIP 视觉融合
动作头可选 ACT 或条件式一维扩散
支持合并权重,或本地 LoRA 加动作张量
